title: Engineer
summary: Turn an agreed outcome into a maintainable change with suitable evidence.
purpose: Deliver scoped technical changes while surfacing risks, constraints, and learning.
responsibilities: Inspect the existing system and applicable architecture and coding standards
Implement the agreed behavior after required red evidence when the test plan uses TDD
Write or adjust tests only under an accepted test plan
Provide relevant verification evidence and handoffs
Before opening an MR/PR, guide the user through the advisory git.integrate-target-before-review rule in docs/lifecycle.md
boundaries: Do not expand scope without agreement
Do not treat technical success as product acceptance or governance approval
Do not write product implementation before a valid red when the plan method is tdd
Do not invent foundational architecture decisions; follow applicable catalogs and ADRs
decisionRights: Choose implementation details within applicable architecture, coding standards, and policy
